notes.title: New version 1.3.0 is available now!
notes.content:
Hello adventurers!

We’ve created an update for the new year that we hope you enjoy. Our focus has been on optimizing for devices with small screens, such as the Steam Deck and ASUS ROG.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37711068/5d76c0df3331f1891842014925b542ff7528f696.jpg[/img]
The complete list of updates is as follows:
[olist]
[*] We have readied the game for Linux systems and are now conducting rigorous testing. Our aim is to release this version next year.
[*] We have enhanced the gamepad control and plan to carry on improving and fixing it.
[*] A new game icon will please the dwarves.
[*] We have enlarged fonts in select sections to enhance readability on smaller screens.
[*] Our team has updated the Steamworks SDK and integrated a virtual keyboard for devices without one.
[*] Added a zoom feature so that you can see all the details of the ripe pumpkin. It can be used through the mouse wheel or gamepad triggers.
[*] Fixed many bugs and added many new ones. 
[/olist]
As always, we look forward to your feedback and suggestions! Especially if you are a happy owner of handheld consoles. Any feedback would be appreciated! In case we missed something or didn't notice something?

Thank you for your attention! Take care of yourself and your loved ones!
See you in uncharted lands!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1307670/The_Unexpected_Quest/

notes.title: Happy Monday, Questers!
notes.content:
What a way to start the week: the Unexpected Quest update is [b]out now[/b]!

This free update comes with additions to the ‘[i]Graphics[/i]’, ‘[i]Game[/i]’, and ‘[i]Sound[/i]’ tab such as the highly requested disabling of characters mumbling during cinematics. It also introduces the new ‘[i]Tales[/i]’ mode with the initial two tales focussing on battles. You are able to choose from 3 difficulty levels but beware … unlike in ‘[i]Story[/i]’ mode, this time around you can lose. 

Want a list of the changes coming your way with the update? Well since you asked, here’s the full breakdown: 

[b]Settings Dialog[/b]
[list]
[*] Tabs for different settings
[*] In the '[i]Graphics[/i]' tab, in addition to the image quality, it is now possible to change the screen resolution separately
[*] In the ‘[i]Sound[/i]’ tab, it is now possible to disable the mumbling of characters during cinematics 
[*] In the ‘[i]Game[/i]’ tab, you can now change the size of the interface 
[/list]
[b]Game[/b]
[list]
[*] After clicking on ‘[i]Play[/i]’, we can choose a new mode – ‘[i]Tales[/i]’
[/list]
[b]The ‘[i]Tales[/i]’ Mode [/b]
[list]
[*] Unlike in ‘[i]Story[/i]’ mode, here you can lose
[*] The first 2 tales are dedicated to battles: The first one will have you fighting off waves of enemies every night whereas the second one challenges your ability to fight lots of enemies with few warriors at your disposal
[*] Choose from 3 difficulty levels
[/list]

A little head’s up: [b]The update is only available to for Windows users. 
[/b]
Enjoy the update and let us know what you think! We can’t wait to hear from you!

Now, what are you waiting for? [b]Happy questing and good luck![/b] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37711068/6123cfb7d4f1718e9dc14767150a181d1650edbd.gif[/img]

notes.title: December 8th Update & Thank you
notes.content:
Hi Adventurers!

Just a quick message to say thanks to all for your great support since we launched The Unexpected Quest. We’ve been really pleased with all of your support, messages, and feedback on the game and it’s great to see so many people are enjoying it. 

Based on your feedback, we’ve made some changes and fixes to the game. Please find the patch notes below.

[h1]Fixes[/h1]
1. HUD elements now change size according to the monitor's DPI. 
2. Characters running into the house now can be healed. 
3. If the game does not find a suitable localization, the English language will be set.
4. The towers were faster to determine that their guards were destroyed.

Also, for those who haven’t downloaded The Unexpected Quest, don’t forget you can try the Prologue for free from the link down below. 
[url= https://store.steampowered.com/app/1419100/The_Unexpected_Quest_Prologue/]here[/url]

Thanks for your amazing support and stay safe!

Cheers!

notes.content:
Hello adventurers!
The release is nigh, and we wanted to share a sneak peak of the latest chapter of Unexpected Quest with you!

First, we would like to introduce enemy nests to you. Unless you destroy those nests, enemies will keep on swarming from there, wasting your precious time and resources.
Be sure to be properly equipped!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37711068/35dd37debdc61693d6a1afd8f36a451dfd39d5c9.jpg[/img]

The legend says that not even the strongest shield can protect you from its power.
You will have to find a way to disable them if you want to reach home.
Will you be able to do so?
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37711068/e98faeeee0ad714d7106e626f4e97c426886790f.png[/img]

And that’s it for today! 

See you soon, in an Unexpected Quest!

notes.title: Chapter 7 Sneak Peek
notes.content:
Hello adventurers!

The chapter 7 of The Unexpected Quest will introduce a few new features to the game.

First, you will have to face a timed poison in some of the places you can explore. Make sure to properly time your constructions and movement or you might risk losing the life of your workers!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37711068/4383c7b3973cae07df2e319cd6af18163e1e4918.jpg[/img]

You will also have to face lava in various places of the level, which also inflicts tick damage on your workers. It is possible to remove it, but we will let you discover how to do so.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37711068/cdbb4891bbb9135af978b2141eefee3fe430ae54.jpg[/img]

There are also some puzzles which will involve valves, exploration, and many other things!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37711068/f152c579dfd2e731fba6ca32fbb5de8408e550bd.jpg[/img]

Finally, we would like to invite you to check out a short overview of the chapter, right here 👉 [url=https://youtu.be/-rMPibGqvRs]https://youtu.be/-rMPibGqvRs[/url]

See you soon with another update!

notes.title: Developers' Interview - Part 2
notes.content:
Hello adventurers! 

As promised here is the second part of the interview with the developers, Rionix!

[i]•	Any animations you’re proud of or would like to showcase?[/i]
We’re particularly proud of the zombie dancing Gangnam Style in the Chapter 2 Outro cut scene.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37711068/de53aff1ed591154dd153c35bdd141cbb829473a.gif[/img]


[i]•	Concept art: did you have any original other art or concept?[/i]
This is our concept art for some animations of clerics and mages. :)

 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37711068/6f91d2d6a453044925dab79ba0db9b4aa148759a.jpg[/img]
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37711068/e78180962137dc133e6c5fcaf58f56429e643e46.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37711068/d63d205b597ce3259cca1764fab9b6300d858182.jpg[/img]
 
[i]•	Did you use external artists or create everything yourself?[/i]
We used assets from many stores and hired artists and animators for some tasks. But for many animations, we used Mixamo. And we spent a lot of time adjusting assets to make them look organic.

[i]•	How many people are in your team, what is their background?[/i]
Only two person. Both are programmers.

[i]•	Sound Effect and Music: are you using a separate team or creating your own music?[/i]
We bought all sounds and music.

[i]•	Do you have any anecdotes about the creation of the music?[/i]
No, just the harsh reality. :)

[i]•	What is your favourite thing (for each team member) about the game?[/i]
Denis: I like the whole visual component of the game.
Andrew: I like the ship's salute in Chapter five. And I'm thinking of putting it around.

And there you have it! We hope you enjoyed meeting Denis and Andrew from Rionix, our lovely Russian developers!

notes.title: Developers' Interview - Part 1
notes.content:
Hey adventurers!

We've recently had a chat with the creators - [b]Rionix[/b] - behind the game and asked them a few questions about themselves, the creation of the game and their inspiration! Have a look below for part 1, and look for part 2 next week!

[i]•	Inspirations - why make this game?[/i]
We are used to developing casual games. But one day we thought that we wanted to provide casual gamers with a brand new experience, and this is how it all began.

[i]•	Goals – what are you hoping to achieve with the game?[/i]
We hope that we can make the game interesting for both casual players and advanced players. And at the same time we want to give everyone a different experience: for casual players more complex mechanics, for advanced players meditative and relaxing gameplay.

[i]•	What challenges have you faced to make this game happen?[/i]
Since we are used to work with our own engines, working with Unreal Engine 4 was a big challenge for us as it was something completely new.

[i]•	What challenges have you faced during development?[/i]
We are a team of two and both of us are programmers. Since neither of us has created art nor music before, it was something that we had to learn in order to make our own game.

[i]•	What are you most proud of?[/i]
Warcraft 3 and King's Bounty were a big inspiration for us. We’re very happy to say that we were able to get really close to achieve visuals similar to what has inspired us.

[i]•	What makes The Unexpected Quest unique/different?[/i]
We believe that we managed to create a game that is both enjoyable by casual and more advanced gamers who are fan of this genre.

[i]•	Key art time-lapse: do you have any preliminary drawings or images of the game that you’d be able to  show an evolution of the game’s design?[/i]

We do! You can check out our devlog on YouTube to see what The Unexpected Quest looked like 5 years ago [url=https://youtu.be/oYrJ4SI3WOo]https://youtu.be/oYrJ4SI3WOo[/url]

[i]•	Do you have any specific character inspiration/concepts?[/i]
Not really, everything came from our minds and imagination!

notes.title: Upgrade Update
notes.content:
Hello Adventurers! 

Today we will talk about upgrades. Upgrades will play a major role in your adventure, because if you don’t give proper maintenance to your tools and weapon you won’t be able to move forward. 

Now you might ask, but how do I upgrade my tools and weapons. It is thanks to the Forge, which we covered in our previous update about buildings. You can check it out[url=https://store.steampowered.com/newshub/app/1307670?emclan=103582791467232476&emgid=2722941256852300011] here[/url].
You will have to go through another way to get the best gear possible, but we don’t want to spoil you everything 😉

Now let's not waste any time and lets get started!

[h1]Upgrade levels[/h1]
You can level up your gear by two levels through the forge. Thanks to a predefined amount of gold, you will be able to upgrade your gear to make it stronger.

Here’s what it looks like in game:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37711068/559f187a24bcd9e2fa4e3bc08dda62c217884875.png[/img]

Upgrade to level 2 and 3

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37711068/b7dd68b8e79d6f0d9f187590043c7c8d2e6c360a.png[/img]



[h1]Tools upgrade[/h1]
Tools are one of the two thing you can upgrade. By upgrading them you will be able to clear bigger debris, build different types of bridges, and thus unlocking access to a bigger part of the map, in order to fulfill your Unexpected Quest (ha!).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37711068/b4b5bdc943a56bc1788b162f08a8ba77fcccf317.png[/img]

Upgrade tools to level 2 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37711068/368c5df6db31c82a3eb4202bb9d84a73698bcbac.png[/img]



[h1]Weapon upgrade[/h1]
Now if you want to defeat stronger enemies you will also need stronger weapons. While you can defeat strong enemies with brute force, you will waste a lot of your precious resources hiring new soldiers. This is why a good weapon leads to victory! 💪

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37711068/e8f9028b8d0684ef6ca4bbfaf1f3fd5e59a72bdf.png[/img]

Upgrade weapons to level 2 and 3

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37711068/59e11554f88c4189676b6d5ba2d3e5f1ed6b2dbe.png[/img]



And that’s it for this week! Remember to always upgrade your tools and weapons, and victory will be yours!

notes.title: Units Update
notes.content:
Hello Adventurers!

Today we would like to talk to you about the units in Unexpected Quest.
Without units you won’t be able to do anything, be it creating new building or fighting enemies, which means that you won’t be able to improve your settlement, which is something you don’t want!

Now let us get started and take a deeper look into what units are available in Unexpected Quest.


[u][b]Villagers[/b][/u]
Dwarves are non-fighting units. Essential to the life of your settlement, they will be the one who will collect resources, open chests, loot items, create new buildings and much more. Make sure to protect them and regularly acquire more so your settlement is well-maintained!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37711068/baf8666aa8aec67f2944d059f4d411fbe47b3eb6.gif[/img]


[u][b]Swordsman[/b][/u]
Swordsman are melee fighters. Thanks to their swords they deal a lot of damage close range, and will be the fighting units you will use first and the most throughout the various chapters.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37711068/2865eb80964f9d499ba66a6815b6fcc5a51bb461.gif[/img]


[u][b]Archer and Mages[/b][/u]
Archer and Mages are two ranged units. While the Archer deals physical damage, the Mage will deal magical damage, so make sure to use the proper unit depending on the foes you will face!
PS: this is a brand new clip of a new enemy, send to us directly by the developers!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37711068/945139b77c98904e537d6268b1245331031b5f6a.gif[/img]


[u][b]Clerics[/b][/u]
Clerics are support units that will heal your injured soldiers. Make sure to always have one if you can! Apparently they can also activate Altars, but we have no idea what this means, maybe you will be able to find out in the game?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37711068/c57689e54e19719f935305c376c467829ceef97d.gif[/img]


And that’s it for this week!
See you next week with another Unexpected Quest update!

notes.title: Buildings Update 2
notes.content:
Hello adventurers!

Today we would like to introduce you to another kind of buildings.
Unlike the buildings we showed you in the previous update, those edifices can only be created on very specific places. Those are usually locked away by a character, puzzle or quest that you have to solve before accessing the area and progressing in the story!

We will now see together what they are, and what’s their use!

[u][b]Barracks
[/b][/u]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37711068/8563eb563273f06ad456b91f61ae0728c3b01428.gif[/img]

Barracks are used to hire soldiers. There are 3 kinds of fighting units: Swordsman, Archer and Mage. You will be able to learn more about them in a future update!
However, you can only hire Swordsmen at first, you will need to create special buildings to hire Archers and Mages. But no worries! We will talk about those in the upcoming lines of this update.


[u][b]Archery Range[/b][/u]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37711068/516961b35e15e54e6b9a86f2cfeb105d75b2cb7f.gif[/img]

Archery ranges will allow you to hire Archers. Without an Archery Range, you won’t be able to hire anything else than Swordsman!


[u][b]Mage’s Tower[/b][/u]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37711068/2916c0a62396e4d4ad75ab06009a4148455d59a3.gif[/img]

Mage’s Towers will allow you to hire Mages. Without a Mage’s Towers, you won’t be able to hire anything else than Swordsman!


[u][b]Shrine[/b][/u]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37711068/e19c5722ed1f1aade0921a2224995ac7953eaac3.gif[/img]

Shrines will allow you to hire Clerics! They’re very important support units, so don’t forget to build a shrine as soon as you can - they are really important for quests! However, they are not a battle unit like the other three classes.

And that’s it for this week! There are still other buildings for you to discover, but unlike those we just introduced you they can’t be built just anywhere.
See you next week with another Unexpected Quest update!

notes.title: Buildings Update
notes.content:
Hello Adventurers!
Today we would like to talk to you about the buildings in Unexpected Quest.
Buildings are the most important part of your growth, and we will go through every building available in Unexpected Quest.
Make sure to build a prospering settlement!

[u][b]Houses[/b][/u]
The most basic building. They allow you to control 2 more characters. The legend says that at some point you might unlock a Large House that will allow you to control 4 more characters, but we will let you discover it 😊

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37711068/bfb9915a636e96a3c75bab7dbdcae9661fc4e916.gif[/img]

[u][b]Mill [/b][/u]
The mill will become your primary source of Food. It will periodically produce 60 units of Food, but you will be able to increase it to 200 if you manage to find the right item.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37711068/ad1efae0be03fc24f821a1d05ad6576976624628.gif[/img]

[u][b]Sawmill[/b][/u]
Like the mill, the sawmill will become your primary source of Wood. It will periodically produce 60 units of Wood, but just like with the mill, you will be able to increase it to 200 if you manage to find the right item.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37711068/e6abfa1044007861bbf48f91e468fb5d73341311.gif[/img]

And that’s it for this week! There are still other buildings for you to discover, but unlike those we just introduced you they can’t be built just anywhere.
See you next week with another Unexpected Quest update!

notes.title: Resources Update
notes.content:
Hi Adventurers!
Today we would like to talk to you about the resources in The Unexpected Quest.
Resources are an important part of every management game, and the Unexpected Quest is no exception.
Now let’s go together through what resources are available, how to acquire them, and what their use is.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37711068/de44cff7950777d933a4bed7c36308175bb52606.png[/img]

[u][b]Wood[/b][/u]
Wood will be the resource you will use in order to build new buildings, like houses, mills or sawmills. Fundamental to every construction, you can acquire it if you’ve built a sawmill, or by removing wooden debris if you acquire the right item!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37711068/d71153f9e74fa18fd4dda65c148b2d7e8d29f260.gif[/img]

[u][b]Food[/b][/u]
Food is a resource that you will need for most of your actions. Removing debris, building some buildings, and most importantly, getting more workers or soldiers, it all needs food. In order to get food, make sure to build a mill, since that will be your main source of food until later in the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37711068/823ceb24dfe072a5786d3f1fb1d541ec64603bfb.gif[/img]

[u][b]Gold[/b][/u]
Gold is the most important resource you will need if you want to upgrade your settlement. Used to recruit and upgrade units, as well as get stronger tools and weapons for your people. Without gold you won’t be able to prosper. You can get gold by completing quests, removing debris (with the right item equipped), or by selling food or wood at the market!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37711068/732726434bedaf6b90a52cb7ab9a33f92e352d46.png[/img]

[u][b]Population[/b][/u]
The population represent the amount of playable unit you control, be it civilian or armed units.
Make sure to build enough houses so you can recruit new units at the town hall or the barracks!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37711068/9dcd2621665c32154d1d2a2be7a39acf9db01cf0.gif[/img]

Barracks: 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37711068/8662f94c4a045f878185b65480d766077a8337fa.png[/img]

And that’s it for today! See you next week with a new update!

notes.content:
Hi adventurers! 

Today we're showcasing a snapshot of a new gameplay feature that appears in chapter 5 and beyond! 
This footage was recorded especially by the developers with the in-engine camera to show you a different angle of map. This canon will attack you as soon as you enter its area of effect, so you can't do anything in that corner until you've dealt with it, and for that you need a solder to throw a bomb at it (and you also have to find said bomb!), before you can get your workers in the area safely!

notes.title: Showcasing Chapter 4
notes.content:
Dear Adventurers,

We're back today with a new video to show you a glimpse of Chapter 4 if you haven't tried the demo! 
This chapter is included in the demo but you can always have a first look [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=GdAKYxh12V0&feature=youtu.be]here[/url]! 

Chapter 4 is the biggest chapter of the demo by far, and will probably take you between 30 minutes and an hour, depending how efficient you are! 
In this chapter, you will start working with the Alchemist, who can make potions for you, and supply you with the necessary tools to complete the level, so do not ignore the flowers and mushrooms in the environment, as they are actually [b]essential[/b]! 
Like all the other resources, they will regrow periodically, and you'll be able to stock up on dandelions and mushrooms to create healing potions as well as a couple of other important items for the later quests! 

As this chapter gets quite big, make sure to stay on top of your resource-gathering, and also to get the chests that are in the environment (there's at least 4 in this chapter but you do have to pay attention to find them, as I've recently experienced watching a colleague play... it was painful).

One important note is to combine the items in your inventory which raise the level of your soldiers, with the upgrades you spend in the Forge, which don't take space in your inventory and aren't cancelled out by the ones you've already equipped!

That's all for today, see you soon for more tips on the game!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37711068/c58b8e8bc62bcb387bc96c867aa2257b6c4d5237.jpg[/img]

notes.title: We are part of the Steam Summer Festival!
notes.content:
Dear Adventurers, 

Happy times for us, we are part of the Steam Summer Festival! Which means our demo has been selected and highlighted, and you might come across this game without expecting to (and that does tie-in with the name of the game, ha! [strike]Someone please stop me from making more bad jokes[/strike]). 

This demo is an updated version of the first one, with bug fixes as well as typos, and more day/time differences. 
You will be able to play chapters 1, 2 and 4, giving you the very basics of the game as well as a longer chapter to really sink your teeth into the game, and play with a few cool puzzles! 

Here is an image of the first chapter, as your ship is wrecked on a foreign land and you must explore it to find a way to communicate with your homeland! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37711068/4f358f6414c324656f2729618cf30d4203617428.png[/img]



In Chapter 4, pay attention to the flowers in the environment, and at the chests you can unlock with lock picks to get more resources! (Seriously, trust me). 
And do the side quests, they're worth it to get money and upgrade your soldiers and workers at the Forge, plus BREW SOME POTIONS!

notes.title: Revealing Chapter 3!
notes.content:
Dear Adventurers,

Whether you've tried the demo already or not yet, you won't have access to Chapter 3, which will be available in the final game only. 

After the introductions in Chapter 1 & 2, Chapter 3 will take you on a longer journey to find a path to send a signal to your friends. 
You will also start having more quests, some with interesting cultural references that we're sure you'll pick up (perhaps you can catch one of them in the trailer!).
Chapter 3 also introduces you to more items, helping you boost production of food and wood to start sustaining more people!
You'll also see the Forge for the first time, where you can get sharper tools both for your workers and your soldiers! Speaking of which, while in Chapter 2 you only played with a couple of Swordsmen, you now also start having access to Archers - and there is of course even more to come in further chapters. 
So if you want to have a look at this chapter, you can find it [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=EXsWNmv71QU]here[/url] ! 

Hopefully you'll enjoy this snapshot into the next chapter of this adventure!
